Specifically, the `crc8_ccitt` function is defined in `subsys/crc/crc8_sw.c`, which is compiled when `CONFIG_CRC8_CCITT` is enabled. According to `subsys/crc/Kconfig`, `CONFIG_CRC8_CCITT` depends on `CONFIG_CRC_DRIVER_HAS_CRC8_CCITT`, which in turn depends on `CONFIG_CRC_DRIVER`. `CONFIG_CRC_DRIVER` is typically selected by a hardware CRC handler (`CONFIG_CRC_HW_HANDLER`), but for software-only contexts (like `qemu_x86` or `native_sim` where this test might run), these options might not be enabled by default.

This will ensure that the software implementation of `crc8_ccitt` is compiled and linked with the test application.
